key_provisions_or_claims: New Article 129a lets Member States apply a zero rate to COVID-19 vaccines and related services.
Member States may apply reduced or zero VAT rates to COVID-19 in vitro diagnostic devices.
Eligible devices must conform to Regulation (EU) 2017/745 (CE marking); vaccines must be authorised.
Measure applies until 31 December 2022, subject to review.
No consultation or impact assessment was carried out because of urgency.
annotation.summary_en: European Commission proposal for a Council Directive amending the VAT Directive 2006/112/EC to let Member States temporarily apply zero or reduced VAT rates to COVID-19 vaccines and in vitro diagnostic devices until end-2022. It has no connection to AI or robotics.
annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Council Directive amending Directive 2006/112/EC as regards temporary measures in relation to value added tax for COVID-19 vaccines and in vitro diagnostic medical devices in response to the COVID-19 pandemic
